title.narrative: Quality and Equal Primary Health Services for all in Somalia QEPHS-Som
Servizi Sanitari di Qualità e Accessibili in Somalia

description.narrative: L’iniziativa proposta ha l’obiettivo di supportare l’ospedale De Martino a Mogadiscio, la Banca Nazionale del Sangue e il National Health Practitioners Council per la fornitura di servizi sanitari accessibili e di qualita’.

The proposed initiative has the objective to support the De Martino hospital in Mogadiscio, the Blood National Bank and the National Health Practitioners Council for the provision of quality health services for all.
